MP High Court Opens Applications for 418 Stenographer and Assistant Posts: Key Dates and Eligibility

Key takeawaysThe Madhya Pradesh High Court (MPHC) in Jabalpur has officially released the notification for the recruitment of Stenographer and Assistant Grade-III positions under Advt. No. 666/Exam/2026. A total of 418 vacancies have been announced for eligible candidates looking to

The Madhya Pradesh High Court (MPHC) in Jabalpur has officially released the notification for the recruitment of Stenographer and Assistant Grade-III positions under Advt. No. 666/Exam/2026. A total of 418 vacancies have been announced for eligible candidates looking to join the state judiciary system.

The application process opened on October 6, 2026. Interested applicants must complete and submit their online forms before the final deadline of October 27, 2026. For candidates who need to make adjustments to their submissions, an application correction window has been scheduled from October 30 to November 1, 2026.

Important Dates and Schedule

  • Online Application Start Date: October 6, 2026
  • Last Date for Application and Fee Payment: October 27, 2026
  • Application Correction Window: October 30 – November 1, 2026

Applicants can pay the required fees online using multiple digital payment modes, including debit cards, credit cards, internet banking, IMPS, cash cards, or mobile wallets, as supported by the portal.

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

Candidates applying for the MP High Court Stenographer and Assistant recruitment must meet specific educational and age requirements as outlined in the official notification.

  • Age Limit: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, while the maximum age ranges between 40 and 45 years, calculated as of January 1, 2026. Age relaxations are applicable according to the established regulations of the Madhya Pradesh High Court.
  • Educational Qualifications: Generally, posts require graduation in any discipline from a recognized university, alongside a valid CPCT Score Card from MAP-IT or an M.P. Government-recognized agency, and a 1-year Diploma in Computer Application (DCA) from an M.P. Government-recognized institution. Specific shorthand speed requirements (such as 80 or 100 W.P.M. in Hindi shorthand) apply depending on the exact post.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

Before initiating the online form submission, applicants are strongly advised to thoroughly review the official notification for detailed post-wise qualifications and category-wise breakdowns.

  • Confirmed Details: The total vacancy count (418), application window (October 6 to October 27, 2026), correction dates, and age criteria are officially verified by the notification source.
  • Unknown/Unspecified Details: Exact salary scales, detailed category-wise seat distribution matrices, and examination dates are not explicitly detailed in the primary announcement summary.
  • How to Verify: Readers can review the complete guidelines, download official notifications, and access direct application links by visiting the [MPHC Official Website](https://mphc.gov.in/) or checking updates via [Sarkari Result](https://sarkariresult.com.cm/mp-high-court-stenographer-assistant-2026/).
